listeningRoomClosingLine: Some songs find you at exactly the right hour.
galleryTagline: Take a piece of the Club with you.
galleryBody: A collection of phone wallpapers, created for your Everlong Midnights. Save your favorites and keep a little magic close.

wallpapers.caption: A little magic goes a long way.

drawingRoomTagline: A quiet place to color, create, and let your mind wander.
drawingRoomBody: A printable coloring page inspired by the Club. Light a candle, pour something good, and make it your own.
drawingRoomClosingLine: Make space for the things that make you feel like you.
kitchenTagline: Something sweet for the morning after.
kitchenImageAlt: Chocolate cake in a mug, fresh from the microwave
recipeBody: Rich, warm, and ready in minutes. Because a softer tomorrow still deserves something sweet.
directions: In a large mug, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Add milk, oil, and vanilla. Stir until smooth.
Microwave for 60-90 seconds (start with 60 and add time as needed).
Let cool for a minute, then enjoy.
allergensBody: Buttermints: contains milk and soy. Everything else in the box is store-bought and individually labeled — check each item's packaging for a full ingredient list before enjoying.

books.title: Garden Spells
books.author: Sarah Addison Allen
books.description: Family, magic, small towns, complicated women, and a garden with a mind of its own. If you're looking for somewhere to go after Midnight, start here.
books.quote: An additional fun read: In The Company of Witches

noteBody: Thank you for being here — for scanning the code, finding the door, and staying a little longer than you needed to.
This box was made slowly, and on purpose, for nights like the one you're having. I hope some part of it found you at the right hour.
backRoomTagline: A quieter corner for the ones who get it.
backRoomBody: Share your thoughts, favorite parts of the evening, what you're watching, reading, drinking, or dreaming about. A little corner of the Club, for you.
